study_scope: 40 coastal plant-pollinator networks from eight Japanese continental/oceanic-island sites across five seasons plus pollination-success observations for 10 plant species
analysis_role: source-native pollinator dependency, interaction breadth, trait matching, and plant pollination-success evidence
permitted_inference: archived plant-pollinator interactions conditional on sampling design
source-native species-level interaction breadth and functional-group use
source-native pollination-success responses when the archived variables and units are explicit
prohibited_inference: pollinator effectiveness from visit identity alone
historical causal attribution from the contemporary network snapshot
floral evolutionary change from network metrics alone
